facts.fact: The FY2026 draft budget (CDMT sectoriels 2026) proposes FCFA 300,000,000 from domestic financing for building urban optical fibre loops (ACDD), under section 85 (Ministry of Digital Economy, Posts and Telecommunications); no appropriation stage is held.
